Summary:
- Target: replace legacy rules engine for FNOL triage and customer support routing with LLM-backed assistant + document ingestion for claims PDFs.
- 3-week POC completed (Sept 17 - Oct 8): integrated Redwood private control plane into staging VPC.
- POC results: embedding quality acceptable; generation latency averaged 110-130ms p95 on dedicated q4 profile vs internal target 50ms for chat-critical flows.
- Cost: Redwood TCO estimate incl. dedicated pools ~$320k ARR; procurement compared to AWS managed endpoints projected ~40% higher first-year ops cost (per CFO analysis).
- Security: Security team validated SOC2 + SSO, but legal/procurement required vendor consolidation onto existing AWS Master Services Agreement.
- Decision: CTO (E. Winters) "we'll consolidate with AWS — one bill, one SLA, less vendor sprawl."
- Internal changes: primary champion (Head of AI, S. Rowe) left company in mid-Oct; no new champion surfaced.
- Final procurement call (Oct 30): procurement confirmed selection of AWS-managed endpoints (SageMaker/Bedrock) and paused any multi-vendor onboarding.
